description.narrative: (Uganda): Providing USAID commodities through the National Medical Stores (NMS) has provided the agency with the opportunity to help optimize NMS' supply chain system as it fulfills its mandate to procure, warehouse, and distribute commodities to the public sector. The Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Software has recently been procured and installed at NMS. This activity will receive $250,000 in FY 2021 funding to provide national level supply chain system support and subnational roll out of the system. The activity will receive additional support from PEPFAR that is not captured in the OP. Successful implementation of the ERP software will ensure accountability for public health commodities, which include reproductive health, family planning, and malaria commodities, and will strengthen national systems for improved supply chain management. The activity will continue to integrate the ERP package that incorporates all supply chain management data for NMS. .
